stem.text: A rigid circular disc of radius $r$ has its centre at X. A number of forces of equal magnitude $F$ act at the edge of the disc. All the forces are in the plane of the disc.
Which arrangement of forces provides a total moment of magnitude $2Fr$ about X?

A.alt: Circle with a point labelled X at its centre and arrows labelled F acting at its edge.

B.alt: Circle with a point labelled X at its centre and an arrow labelled F acting at its edge.

C.alt: Circle with a point labelled X at its centre and arrows labelled F acting at its edge.

D.alt: Circle with a point labelled X at its centre and three arrows labelled F acting at its edge.
